articles.summary: The biotech’s experimental drug, currently in Phase 1 testing, has drawn investor attention despite a difficult funding environment for drug startups.
articles.title: BioPharma Dive: Upstream Bio raises $200M in fresh funding for asthma drug

articles.summary: The company said Thursday it has closed $200 million in Series B financing—on top of last year’s $200 million Series A haul—to help initiate a registrational Phase II study for its lead candidate UPB-101.
articles.title: BioSpace: Upstream Bio Adds Another $200M for Asthma, Allergy Pipeline
